assertions.name: Empty builds explain why selection tools are unavailable
Escape returns keyboard focus to tool search toggle
Searching roof opens the starter library and moves focus there
Preview actions are in the fixed dock footer
Review exposes one explicit Apply action without modifying blocks
Review frames a starter placed away from the current camera
Returning to tools keeps the proposal available
Tool navigation preserves a partially typed project name and the pending preview
Applying the reviewed starter produces one undoable change
One undo restores the original empty world
Escape cancels the proposal and removes its scene overlay
Phone finder provides a scrollable tool list without page overflow
Phone Apply stays visible and meets a 44px touch target
Phone world review keeps all actions within the viewport
Short landscape can reach the matching tool

scope: Local Chromium, actual WebGL; desktop, narrow touch portrait, and short landscape.
